text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san... um, how do you handle it? 
Organizing all the race footage, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, the files I uploaded to the 
cloud are about to hit the storage 
limit...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Eh? Is there an archive exclusively 
for Trainers?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I see, that's a relief then...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Could those archives happen to include 
legendary Umamusume debut races, 
international races, and regional races 
that are currently hard to find...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um! Um, er... I-Is that something 
students are allowed to look at...?!
